scripts.//vendor: GSAP is staged into public/vendor/gsap/ rather than bundled, so it must run before anything serves a page — the client bundle references window.gsap and the page reads the staged VERSION to build its cache-busting query. Ahead of build-client on every path, including dev, so a dev server can never be the one arrangement that lacks it.
scripts.build: pnpm vendor && node scripts/build-client.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: pnpm vendor && node scripts/build-client.mjs && tsx watch src/index.ts
